version_evaluated: First release, before the feedback-driven redesign
method: One operator. Five distinct real businesses from ordinary and curated runs, selected by route. Routing was recorded before draft review. Source excerpts were visible; some excerpts included system assessments.
interpretation: Website ownership agreement and next-action agreement measure this selected packet only. The original draft required editing.

subsequent_walkthrough.method: Qualitative operator walkthrough after the blind packet. No business owner was contacted.
subsequent_walkthrough.outcome: The operator considered the outreach message acceptable and would withhold the website.
subsequent_walkthrough.feedback: The headline split a word. The operator wanted real work pictured on the page, a larger contact number, a realistic estimate form, and a way to watch several leads progress together.

evening_walkthrough.method: Qualitative operator walkthrough of real Paintastic and a ten-business rehearsal, followed by manual spot checks of the ordinary discovery batch.
evening_walkthrough.outcome: The operator liked the revised Paintastic concept and the ten-business board. McCormick and Tony were two independently spotted misses in the nine holds.
evening_walkthrough.feedback: A contact-first home, selection from any batch row, copyable replay drafts, an inspectable graph and retrieval, Instagram project photos and sourced reviews.
